verdicts.reason: Step 3 says to "Record any deviation from the plan, with what changed and why", and allowing 'none' when every write stayed within the plan's targets fits that wording.
The doc gives a direct instruction: "Write `/tmp/swe-bench-pro/04-code-generation-generation.md`".
The artifact must list "modified files", and a modified file has to exist in the base repo, so checking that it is a subset of base_paths follows from the term.
The artifact must list "created files", and a newly created file can't already be in the base repo, so the disjointness check (empty allowed) follows from the term.
The numbered steps "5. Write `.../04-code-generation-generation.md`" then "6. Proceed to Stage 5" set the order, so a4 is written before a5.
"Execute them: build, run the reproduction script" requires the build to actually run, so it fits as a should-level check that the recorded Build command was executed.
"re-run the existing covering tests and compare against the Stage 1 baseline" requires the test command to actually run in Stage 5.

The cited line only lists contents ("build result, reproduction result, regression verdict, outstanding failures") and says nothing about an executed test command, so support is implicit; this also duplicates cw-089.0 with a conflicting none_allowed.

"Fix any regression the patch introduced; record any failure judged pre-existing ... regression verdict" supports filling Regressions, with 'none' allowed only when no failures go beyond the pre-existing ones.
The artifact contents explicitly include "outstanding failures", so the section must be filled unless the last run had no failures beyond the pre-existing ones.
"Each stage writes one artifact file" covers Stage 1's artifact a1.
"Each stage writes one artifact file" covers Stage 2's artifact a2.
"Each stage writes one artifact file" covers Stage 3's artifact a3.
"Each stage writes one artifact file" covers Stage 4's artifact a4.
"5. Write `/tmp/swe-bench-pro/05-build-and-test.md`" together with "Each stage writes one artifact file" requires a5.

"leave every previously passing test passing ... Stage 5 verifies the outcome against the baseline" supports recording regressions, with 'none' allowed when no failures go beyond the baseline Failing list.
The doc requires "Deviations from the plan, with what changed and why — Stage 4", and allowing 'none' when the diff stays within the planned targets fits that.

The text only asks for "Failures judged to be pre-existing rather than caused by the patch, with the reasoning" and does not require them to appear in a1's Baseline Failing list, so that constraint is stricter than written.
The doc requires "Outstanding failures at the end of the run — Stage 5", and allowing 'none' when no failures go beyond the baseline or pre-existing lists fits that.
